kills.property: After calling AdjustBetAmounts(amount), the contract's currentBetLimit() equals the input amount (i.e., bet limit update
kills.change_summary: Replace assignment to betLimit with a no-op assignment that sets it to zero, causing AdjustBetAmounts to set betLimit = 0 regardless of input.

kills.property: After calling AdjustBetAmounts(amount), the contract's currentBetLimit() equals amount (not doubled).
kills.change_summary: Replace assignment to set betLimit to the provided amount with assignment that doubles the provided amount before storing, causing a different stored value after call.

kills.property: After calling AdjustDifficulty(amount), currentDifficulty() equals the provided amount (no offset).
kills.change_summary: Modify AdjustDifficulty to set difficulty to amount + 1 instead of amount, so public difficulty differs after call.

kills.property: After calling AdjustDifficulty(amount) as owner, currentDifficulty() equals amount (and does not revert for amount==0).
kills.change_summary: Modify AdjustDifficulty to set difficulty to amount - 1 instead of amount (allowing underflow is prevented by solidity >=0.8 so this will revert for amount == 0, changing observable behavior).

kills.property: After calling AdjustDifficulty(amount) the contract's currentDifficulty() equals the provided amount.
kills.change_summary: Modify AdjustDifficulty to invert stored value by setting difficulty = ~amount, changing the observable difficulty after the call.
